The GEM Peru project will generate a broad range of socio-economic benefits by promoting circularity and resource efficiency across the electronics value chain. These benefits are expected to contribute to long-term resilience, community sustainability, and improved well-being, particularly for vulnerable groups. Health improvements and reduced exposure to hazardous chemicals: By promoting safer manufacturing processes, resource-efficient practices, and the environmentally sound disposal of hazardous substances, the project will significantly reduce the exposure of workers and communities to harmful chemicals, including POPs and Hg-containing materials. This will result in improved health outcomes, particularly for those working in recycling sector, reducing the incidence of respiratory issues, skin conditions, and other long-term health risks associated with exposure to toxic substances. Creation of sustainable livelihoods and economic empowerment: The project will enhance economic opportunities by supporting the development of a circular electronics economy in Peru. By promoting the reuse, repair, recycling, and safe disposal of electronics, the project will create green jobs in various segments of the electronics value chain. It will particularly benefit small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and informal sector workers by providing capacity-building opportunities, access to new markets, and incentives for adopting safer, more sustainable practices. Capacity building for enhanced resilience: Through knowledge-sharing platforms, training programs, and pilot demonstrations, the project will build the capacity of government institutions, private sector actors, and local communities to adopt circular economy principles. Improved technical expertise and institutional coordination will contribute to stronger policy frameworks and enhanced resilience to environmental and economic shocks. Economic growth through innovation and market competitiveness: By promoting eco-friendly alternatives and establishing incentive mechanisms for sustainable manufacturing, the project will enhance Peru’s competitiveness in regional and international markets. Encouraging innovation and adopting cleaner production techniques will boost the country's ability to participate in the global circular economy, creating lasting economic value. Improved resource efficiency and waste management: The project’s focus on resource-efficient value chains will result in reduced resource consumption, increased recycling rates, and minimized waste generation. This will contribute to more sustainable use of natural resources and reduce environmental pollution, thereby improving overall environmental quality and supporting community health and well-being. Promotion of inclusive and equitable growth: The project will integrate gender-responsive approaches, ensuring that women, youth, and other marginalized groups have access to training, employment, and entrepreneurial opportunities within the circular electronics sector. This inclusive approach will promote social cohesion and contribute to broader socio-economic stability.

To significantly reduce the production of electronic waste and increase circularity and resource recovery in the electronics sector of Peru, through the creation of an enabling environment, for policy, legislative, technological and consumer change, including access to finance, technology and policy and legislative change that fosters responsible electronics management.
